2608.14465.title: You Only Pass Once: Answering and Abstaining Together in a Single Forward Pass of a Frozen Language Model
2608.14465.paper_summary: A frozen language model on reasoning tasks has two coupled weaknesses: it under-uses evidence its own residual stream already encodes, and it fails to detect when the input is insufficient to answer, so it confabulates. This paper consolidates two research lines that address these on the same residual stream: a conditional steering probe writes the stream at mid-stack layers and recovers reasoning accuracy from a frozen backbone, and a zero-shot sufficiency direction reads the stream and abstains when information is insufficient. Deployed in one forward pass they interfere: the steering write shifts the state the direction reads, costing up to 8 AUROC points of cross-domain transfer on small models; a separate clean pass doubles inference cost. We keep the direction fixed and train a small network to reconstruct the pre-steering residual from the steered one -- mean-squared error on (steered, clean) pairs, no sufficiency labels -- and read the direction on the reconstruction. The resulting system, YOPO (You Only Pass Once), answers, steers, and abstains in one forward pass of a frozen Qwen2.5 backbone (1.5B/3B/7B). End to end, three-way accuracy more than doubles the frozen baseline (0.375->0.798 on 1.5B alphaNLI) and one pass beats the two-pass reference at every scale (0.798/0.830/0.893 vs 0.753/0.790/0.863) and on ten backbones across six model families. We chart the capacity-transfer frontier quantifying the principle that abstention should not be trained in; a source-side audit catches our own alphaNLI construction leaking a surface artifact, so architectural claims are anchored on native-label replications (SQuAD2, RepLiQA, MuSiQue); and on the standard four-domain suite we contribute, to our knowledge, the first answer-or-abstain benchmark, where our gate tops every in-domain dataset and the label-free direction is the only gate family to survive domain transfer.
2608.14465.paper_summary_zh: 一個在推理任務上的凍結語言模型有兩個相互關聯的弱點：它未充分利用其自身殘差流已編碼的證據，並且未能檢測到輸入不足以回答的情況，因此會進行虛構。本文整合了兩條研究線路，針對同一殘差流解決這些問題：一個條件引導探針在中間堆疊層寫入流並從凍結的骨幹中恢復推理準確性，而一個零樣本充分性方向則讀取流並在信息不足時選擇不作答。在一次前向傳遞中，它們互相干擾：引導寫入改變了方向讀取的狀態，對於小型模型來說，這會損失高達8個AUROC點的跨域轉移；而單獨的清晰傳遞則使推理成本翻倍。我們保持方向固定，訓練一個小型網絡從引導後的殘差重建引導前的殘差——對於（引導後，清晰）對的均方誤差，無需充分性標籤——並在重建上讀取方向。最終系統YOPO（You Only Pass Once）在凍結的Qwen2.5骨幹（1.5B/3B/7B）的一次前向傳遞中回答、引導和選擇不作答。整體而言，三方準確率比凍結基線翻倍以上（0.375->0.798在1.5B alphaNLI上），並且在每個規模上，一次傳遞超過兩次傳遞的參考（0.798/0.830/0.893對比0.753/0.790/0.863），並且在六個模型系列的十個骨幹上進行了測試。我們繪製了容量轉移邊界，量化了不應訓練選擇不作答的原則；源端審計捕捉到我們自己的alphaNLI構建洩漏了一個表面工件，因此架構主張基於原生標籤的複製（SQuAD2、RepLiQA、MuSiQue）；在標準的四域套件上，我們貢獻了，據我們所知，第一個回答或不作答的基準，其中我們的閘門在每個域內數據集上表現最佳，而無標籤的方向是唯一能夠在域轉移中存活的閘門系列。
